newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Surgical holders OK reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Surgical holders OK reverse split.

text.p: Sparta Surgical Corp said on Thursday that its shareholders approved a one-for-six reverse stock split effective March 28, 1997.
The number of outstanding shares will fall to 763,749 from 4,582,492, the company said.
The stock split was recommended so the company would remain in compliance with the Nasdaq SmallCap Market's listing requirements, Sparta Surgical said.
The company's shares will have temporary stock symbols until Nasdaq has confirmed that the company meets terms of the minimum bid price requirement, Sparta Surgical said.
